marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The Wubbulous World of Dr. Seuss. 9 : THE CAT IN THE HAT'S ART HOUSE and 3 other adventures

This daytime Emmy-nominated preschool series features the fun, music and adventures of some of the favourite characters created by celebrated children's author Theodore Geisel (aka Dr. Seuss). With puppets built by Jim Henson's Creature Shop, the show helps children understand valuable lessons about friendship, imagination and much more. " The Wubbulous World of Dr. Seuss" is fun entertainment for the whole family
